EMERGENCY APPLICATION TO JUSTICE ALITO
Dear Clerk of Court Harris:
Enclosed is an Original and two copies of an Emergency Application
to Fifth Circuit Justice ALITO. It deals with a major ruling by Justice
GORSUCH, Henson v. Santander, 598 U.S._ (2017). IfJustice ALITO
denies, can THIS be the Rule 22.4 request to refer it to Justice
GORSUCH now better than later? The compelling reasons for an
emergency stay are set forth in Exhibit Cl. Stays were denied at the
District Court and effectively at the Court of Appeals. The issues are of
compelling national import and billions of dollars are escaping to the
Cayman Islands. Time is of the essence. SCOTU s e ast resort.
